name: FastWan2.2 TI2V 5B FullAttn — native ComfyUI 3-step profile

recommended_benchmark.validation_scope: Each production shot still requires visual and performance review.

native_mapping.mapping: Comfy ModelSamplingDiscreteFlow.timestep(sigma) = 1000 * sigma. Explicit ManualSigmas values are already the final noise levels and must not be shifted a second time.
native_mapping.reason_for_lcm: The official DMD loop predicts x0 = x - sigma * v, then draws fresh Gaussian noise and sets x_next = (1 - sigma_next) * x0 + sigma_next * noise. Native sample_lcm with CONST uses these same operations. Euler advances the same noisy state and is not the official DMD update.
native_mapping.equivalence_limit: Native sigma values match the exact integer timesteps sent to the source DiT. The source uses the nearest entry of its shift-8, 1000-entry training table for denoising/re-noising coefficients. This native profile differs in those coefficients by at most 0.000260875. It is a documented native approximation, not bitwise parity with FastVideo. RNG layout, LoRA reconstruction and FP16 also differ.
native_mapping.lora_alpha: The checkpoint has rank-128 up/down tensors and no alpha tensors. Use Comfy native strength_model=1.0; do not multiply strength by 128.

quality_limits: FastVideo's current support matrix reports I2V quality issues for Wan2.2 TI2V 5B; inspect face identity and motion before production batches.
The 3-step student and extracted LoRA are speed-oriented and do not establish equivalence to the full-step base model.

TITAN RTX measured render times: 368.28 s for 704x1280/121 frames and 520.43 s for 736x1312/145 frames. VAE remains FP32 and took 298.761 s in the second run; these are single-run measurements, not batch latency guarantees.

Both local FastWan samples showed visible brightening and stronger cyan/amber saturation during the first second. Identity and clothing were usable in the inspected sample frames; hands, props and walking need independent per-shot review.

local_benchmark_evidence.vae_memory_measurement_scope: PyTorch CUDA allocator in isolated worker; not driver-wide GPU memory
local_benchmark_evidence.production_use: Non-critical-lipsync shots with individual visual review; root director owns adoption and retakes.

fallback.note: Project baseline measured on S01 quality_01: 1196.89 s render at 736x1312/145 frames with native VAE decode. Color was more stable, but sustained closed eyes failed the intended attentive performance, so quality_02 was requested. This is not a claim of equivalence to the upstream 50-step pipeline.
